# ferriskey_client_saml_attribute_mapper (Resource)

Manages a SAML attribute mapper of a FerrisKey client, i.e. one user attribute released in the SAML assertion. The API has no update endpoint, so every attribute change forces a new resource. Attribute names must be unique per client.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_client_saml_attribute_mapper" "mail" {
  realm       = "acme"
  client_uuid = ferriskey_client.saml.client_uuid
  name        = "mail"
  source      = "user:email"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_uuid` (String) UUID of the SAML client. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the attribute in the SAML assertion. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm owning the client. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `source` (String) Where the value comes from: `user:id`, `user:username`, `user:email`, `user:first_name`, `user:last_name` or `attribute:<key>` for a custom user attribute. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `name_format` (String) SAML attribute name format URN. One of `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:attrname-format:basic` (default), `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:attrname-format:uri` or `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:attrname-format:unspecified`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the form `{realm}/{client_uuid}/{mapper_id}`.
- `mapper_id` (String) UUID of the attribute mapper.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by {realm}/{client_uuid}/{mapper_id}.
terraform import ferriskey_client_saml_attribute_mapper.mail acme/3a8c6128-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/7b1d9e44-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
